one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Knack Packaging is an integrated, export-led manufacturer of printed and laminated woven polypropylene (PLWPP) bulk packaging bags, holding ~10.1% share of the Indian flexible bulk PLWPP bag market (FY2025).

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Knack Packaging designs and manufactures customized, high-strength PLWPP woven bags and PLWPP pinch bottom bags (5kg-50kg) for food, pet food, agriculture, chemicals, building materials and other bulk applications, under a B2B2C model. It is vertically integrated from PP granule processing through tapes, fabric, printing, lamination to finished bags, and is the first company in India (and Asia) to integrate laser-cut easy-open features into PLWPP pinch bottom bags. It exports to 71 countries.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Knack Packaging SA (RF) Proprietary Limited — Subsidiary (South Africa, est. 2021): Imports and sells Knack products (HDPE/PP tapes, woven fabrics/bags, BOPP laminated PP woven bags)
- Sayem Knack S.A. de C.V. — Joint venture (with Sacos y Empaques Internacionales): Strategic expansion in Latin America and the USA
- Knack Packaging (FZC) SPC — Foreign entity: Under liquidation
- Knack Energy Private Limited / Knack International Private Limited / ADP Packaging Private Limited — Promoter group / related companies: Directorships held by promoters

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Woven PP packaging:** Printed and Laminated Woven Polypropylene (PLWPP) bags, PLWPP Pinch Bottom bags (with laser-cut/easy-open), BOPP laminated PP woven bags, Block Bottom bags, Four Layer Metallized bags with windows, Shopping bags / bottom gusseted bags, HDPE/PP tapes, woven fabrics, woven bags
- **Add-on features:** Circular & back seam construction, half/full/register window, zig-zag cut, heatcut, bladecut, RFID/barcode/QR/NFC tagging, hot stamping

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Vertically integrated from PP granule processing through tapes, fabric, printing, lamination to finished PLWPP bags at Gujarat facilities, with in-house printing (73,000+ cylinders for 1,950+ customers, 13,379 SKUs). Digitised operations via proprietary Knack Galaxy platform integrated with SAP S4 HANA and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. Raw materials (mainly PP granules) sourced on spot orders from top-10 suppliers (73%-86% of purchases); small imports (~2.4%-2.5%) from Singapore, South Korea, Thailand. South Africa subsidiary and Sayem Knack JV (commenced April 6, 2026) support Latin America/US expansion. 80% of energy from renewable sources (rooftop solar, windmill, 11 MW solar farm).

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue growth (26.25% FY24, 12.52% FY25, 11.81% FY26) with rising volumes (30,590 MT -> 38,157 MT)
- Margin expansion: EBITDA margin 15.38% (FY24) -> 19.31% (FY25) -> 20.42% (FY26); EBITDA per kg Rs 33.14 -> Rs 45.15
- Deleveraging: Debt-Equity 1.23 (FY24) -> 0.80 (FY25) -> 0.62 (FY26); high RoCE (45%-50%) and RoE (36%-42%)
- Vertical integration and renewable energy (80% of energy from renewables) supporting cost control

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Set up a new manufacturing facility at Borisana, Kadi, Mehsana, Gujarat (fresh-issue funded capex)
- Deepen expansion in Latin America and the USA via the Sayem Knack JV and the South Africa subsidiary
- Increase renewable energy share and sustainability (recycled/renewable materials, waste reprocessing)
- Continue product innovation in value-added PLWPP pinch bottom bags

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The company is setting up a new manufacturing facility at Borisana (Kadi, Mehsana, Gujarat), partially funded by the fresh issue, to add capacity beyond the current 43,300 MTPA. History includes an additional Indrad, Gujarat facility (from 2020), rooftop solar (2022), a windmill (2023) and an 11 MW solar farm operationalized in FY2025.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- ~10.1% share of the Indian flexible bulk PLWPP bag market (FY2025); early mover in BOPP/PLWPP bags
- First in India and Asia to integrate laser-cut easy-open features into PLWPP pinch bottom bags
- Vertically integrated manufacturing (PP granule to finished bag) with in-house printing and 73,000+ cylinders for 1,950+ customers / 13,379 SKUs
- Highest EBITDA margin (18.1%-18.5%), RoE and RoCE among the selected direct peer group (FY2025)
- Export presence across 71 countries; Two Star Export House; multiple export-excellence awards
- Digitised operations (proprietary Knack Galaxy platform, SAP S4 HANA, MS Dynamics 365)

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Supplier concentration and PP granule price risk — Top-10 suppliers were 73%-86% of raw material purchases with no long-term contracts; PP granules are the key input
- Customer concentration — Largest supplier/customer concentration and reliance on top brands under B2B2C model
- Single-region manufacturing (Gujarat) — All manufacturing concentrated in Gujarat, exposing operations to regional disruption
- Export exposure (71 countries) — Export-led model exposed to trade policy, tariffs and FX volatility
- Raw material (PP) price volatility — Polypropylene prices are volatile and linked to crude oil
- Commissioned Technopak industry report — Market-share/industry data derive from a report exclusively commissioned and paid for by the company
- Working capital intensity — Inventory buffers of PP granules and receivables tie up working capital

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Set up a new manufacturing facility at Borisana, Kadi, Mehsana, Gujarat, partially funded by the fresh issue**
- **Increase renewable energy share of total energy requirements to 90% by 2030 (currently 80%)**
- **Achieve a 10% reduction in energy consumption per kilogram of production by 2030**
- **Achieve a 30% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions per kilogram by 2030**
- **Achieve a 5% reduction in production wastage via scrap reprocessing**
- **Deepen strategic expansion in Latin America and the USA via the Sayem Knack JV**
